records.name: Blue Hurricane
records.effect: Rapidly spinning aerial Ki Blast attack; current documentation describes a large twister that can be moved with the control stick.
records.notes: 2026-09-25 taxonomy parity correction: current Xenoverse 2 skill documentation and the live canonical/index projection classify Blue Hurricane as a Strike Ultimate; the earlier Ki Blast classification in this historical batch was stale. Acquisition evidence (EM15 Basic Reward) is unchanged.

records.name: Assault Rain
records.unlock_method: Expert Mission 9 — "The Most Feared Majin" Basic Reward
records.effect: Wide-area barrage of falling Ki blasts; current documentation describes tracking, long-range, 10-hit behavior.

records.name: Spirit Ball
records.effect: Controllable Ki Blast sphere; additional inputs make the projectile track the opponent, with up to 18 observed hits.

records.name: Death Meteor
records.unlock_method: Expert Mission 7 — The Big Gete Star Strikes Back
records.effect: Launches multiple tracking meteor projectiles while the user is protected by an invisible barrier during the attack.

records.name: Minus Energy Power Ball
records.unlock_method: Shenron wish — I want another new Ultimate Attack! (additional wishes unlocked through Guru)
records.effect: Condenses negative energy into a large projectile; setup can hit the opponent before launch, and the attack is documented as a 39-hit long-range Ki Blast Ultimate.

notes: Batch 311 evidence refresh corrected Blue Hurricane character attribution from the stale Gogeta entry to Burter, established 300 Ki and EM15 Basic Reward provenance, and established Assault Rain at 300 Ki with Super Buu provenance and EM9 Basic Reward provenance. CaC availability, drop probability, exact frame data, and version-sensitive damage remain unresolved. Batch 311 follow-up: Spirit Ball, Death Meteor, and Minus Energy Power Ball were reconciled from current Xenoverse 2 evidence. Death Meteor is retained as Strike rather than forcing it into the Ki Blast subcategory solely because this batch originated as Ki Blast research. 2026-09-25 follow-up: Blue Hurricane taxonomy corrected from Ki Blast to Strike to match current canonical/index classification and the maintained Strike Ultimate catalog; no acquisition semantics were changed.
